title: Street Light Ko Kaise Pata Chalta Hai Ki Raat Ho Gayi? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Street light ghadi nahi dekhti, phir bhi shaam hote hi khud jal jaati hai. Iska raaz hai ek chhota sa LDR sensor!
🌞 LDR kya hai: roshni se badalne wala resistor
📈 Andhere mein resistance 1,000 ohm se 10 lakh ohm tak kaise badhta hai
⚡ Voltage threshold cross hote hi switch kaise click karta hai
🌅 Subah light apne aap band kyun ho jaati hai
Aise hi electronics ke raaz simple Hindi mein samajhne ke liye channel subscribe karo! 🔔
